notes: Null means the register or VCP code was attempted but did not produce a readable value.
Unattempted registers are omitted from subset scans and listed in attempted_registers instead.
Only captures with explicit high-confidence state metadata are included here.

notes.0x02: Scaler sanity check; clean captures should read 0x79.
notes.0x48: Display mode byte; interpretation still under investigation.
notes.0xA1: Signal presence; 0x00 is the reliable idle indicator.
notes.0xE1: Menu1 OSD guard; 0xFA indicates the scan should be discarded.

notes.0x60: Primary source in PBP, main source in PIP.
